title: Trick (1999) is a well-executed gay rom com

commenti.body:
And the scene with Coco in the club restroom is worth the whole film.  The production value is definitely up there for independent gay films of the 90s and it’s a solid rom-com gay or straight.  

It’s actually one of my favorite sub-genre of film that I like to call “survive the night”.  It’s not as dire as some but they do have their obstacles along the way both external and internal.
